FORMAL UX AND ACCESSIBILITY REVIEW — APPROVE

Reviewer identity: codex-mockup-ux-review.
Candidate: cand-3CM1JDY29SG3WPSV74GVS08WNF.
Exact commit: dda53463a1556f1b18bfd8a24c937d439fc89dfc.
Tree: 7fd21caf66b562c48c635ba38844ad00ffd7303b.
Direct base: 003f12b21e1b9793fea479e104c2e2eff3e55fe5.
Scope checked: mockups/mockup-v2-design-brief.md and mockups/v2 only.

Method and evidence

I reviewed a fresh git-archive export of the exact commit, reran verify-manifest.cjs and fixture-court.cjs, inspected all 13 final PNG plates at their original pixel dimensions, inspected the corresponding frozen HTML and manifest courts, and compared the changed Main, RecallMatrix, StateBoard, and InterviewMode plates with the previously approved visual baseline. The manifest reproduced artifact digest 3dd04832dbbe9a3501f5af3048378a62d9809362aa10e04164ac550835dca9e8 and reproducible digest d3a378c3444d3e6d435ba6b1f9e4663499be52a895bb03fb9b0f13d5f84a5530.

Verdict

APPROVE for the static design candidate. I found no acceptance-level UX or accessibility blocker. The science repairs increase precision without damaging the persistent Codex, replaceable projection, tertiary inspector hierarchy or the one-question-at-a-time interaction thesis.

Prior UX blockers retested

UX-B1 PASS — frozen and inert semantics. All 13 manifest plates declare lang, title, viewport metadata and the conspicuous inert-controls notice. The manifest records zero scripts, zero active event semantics, zero external resources and no unresolved directives. An independent frozen-HTML scan found no button-like role, nonnegative tabindex, aria-pressed or event handler. The drawn controls are visibly a specification, not falsely operable UI.

UX-B2 PASS AS DESIGN CONTRACT — SVG and accessibility twin. FocusOrder specifies inert SVG paint plus one visible DOM composite using aria-activedescendant, with descendants outside the tab sequence and bundled or hidden members retained as deterministic rows. The matrix twin is explicitly 11 by 16 and includes zero, off-source and Unranked cells; arrows move one cell, Home and End move to row edges, and Ctrl plus Home or End moves to grid corners. Printable-character commands require a modifier, are focused-instrument scoped, remappable and disableable, and suspend in input, textarea, select and contenteditable contexts. PROOF-BOUNDARY correctly leaves runtime tree shape, announcements and focus behavior to the application court.

UX-B3 PASS — exact-text typography and visibility. Main, RecallMatrix, InterviewMode and Compact report exact-text minima of 16px with 24.8px leading; Reflow uses 32px with 48px leading. Exact source, recall and interview text is DOM text, not matrix-label paint. Every court reports clippedEvidence empty, and the declared text and inspector scroll regions are reachable. The changed claims and feature wording do not shrink or clamp exact evidence.

UX-B4 PASS — Compact reachability. All s01 through s10 units are present in the Compact DOM, the Codex is a declared vertical scroll region, and the footer truthfully says 10 of 10 loaded, continuous scroll and s10 reachable. The former false one-page implication is absent. The inspector is represented by a persistent collapsed rail rather than removed.

UX-B5 PASS — failure state. StateBoard has a visually and textually distinct Provider or compiler failed panel with FAILED — NO VALUE EMITTED plus stage, provider, error, attempt, retry and lastValid fields. It explicitly distinguishes failure from Missing, No data and Unresolved and displays no partial numeric value.

UX-B6 PASS — fixture honesty. The affected plates carry dominant synthetic labels; Main and Compact say unadmitted and not human adjudicated; recall and interview explicitly deny participant data and a conducted interview. The bundle does not call this fixture researcher-reviewed. Unestablished is visibly a proposed StoryAtlas view state and not a pinned provider type.

Visual and cognitive-load findings

- Main still gives the largest workspace column to the Narrative Codex, one center projection to the Atlas, and a narrower collapsible inspector. Shared selection is redundant in text, border, placement chips and coordinates. The revised chronology and claim language weakens unsupported interpretations without adding another competing panel.
- RecallMatrix keeps exact source and recall prose in the Dual Narrative Codex and declares matrix summaries as summaries. Source, Distorted, five named off-source destinations and held Unranked mass remain differentiated by position, fill texture, outline and written labels rather than hue alone.
- InterviewMode keeps the transcript as the observation, labels the hypothesized episode as derived, and makes no source-coverage or veridicality claim. The proposed state notice is prominent and non-colour-dependent.
- StateBoard is long but correctly flowing. Missing, zero, not requested, unauthorized, low coverage, unresolved, off-source, unranked, stale, privacy-blocked, loading, no-data and failure states all have distinct marks and explicit not-this explanations.
- Grayscale and dichromat plates preserve the scientific encodings through patterns, borders, positions and labels. Motion provides a complete zero-millisecond treatment with tether, ghost, breadcrumb, announcement and receipt rather than a shortened animation.

Non-blocking production notes retained in the record

UX-N1 — The known-source Dual Codex is still about 300px wide. Its 16px prose is readable but forced to roughly 20 to 30 characters per line. The live dual-rail mode should permit widening or split inspection and must be tested with representative long prose.

UX-N2 — FocusOrder calls the diagram twelve tab stops while also saying Tab walks inspector fields and moves among four control groups. Treat the numbered items as twelve regions or task landmarks, then separately specify and test the actual tabbable count.

UX-N3 — The absolute frozen notice overlaps trailing top-banner metadata in Tokens and RendererGap. It does not cover exact evidence, but a successor export should reserve notice width or wrap the banner so all receipt context remains visible.

UX-N4 — The expanded Main claim list uses 10px tertiary text and a narrow label column, so long claim identifiers fragment heavily. The live inspector should use progressive disclosure and prove the full field list at 200 percent rather than preserving this density literally.

Boundary

This approval is for the immutable static design bundle only. It is not runtime accessibility, keyboard, reflow, export, privacy, performance or renderer proof. The unresolved graph-over-text work remains outside this certification: the candidate demonstrates a plausible Codex plus Atlas split, but it does not settle the O3 comparison or authorize implementation, landing or an Intaglio API change.

Candidate evidence consulted: evid-8550130fd3156c6960eabeee8e9c7186618a31aabf4183f5ea7d061c42f11bf0, evid-c26ab7a757dbcda0649776cd989aa253a39979060ace7b7db1d3cb859593ff87, evid-eea4c892973a6e26ef360d34b460d6b9d65c0968b9d5ee4aed937da2731afb4a and evid-ca1530077c9685abf0f6349dc9b0f9c95b7554582e0f8f926010e2257993e69c.

No files were edited, staged, authorized, landed or pushed.
